description_zh: Zoox自动驾驶车辆在Chess Drive西行直行，右侧停车位一辆平行停放的乘用车突然切入本车道，未让行且未打转向灯，触发时机急促（trig_ttc=1.5），两车侧面接触。

source_snippets: A Zoox vehicle (Vehicle 1) in autonomy was traveling westbound on Chess Drive in Foster City when a parallel-parked passenger car (Vehicle 2) abruptly entered the Zoox vehicle’s travel lane from a parking space in the right parking lane without yielding or activating a turn signal.
evidence.reason: 报告明确描述AV直行，对方车辆从右侧相邻车位突然切入，使用cut_in原语及abruptly→trig_ttc=1.5映射即可表达。
